links.comparator_used: Predictions without conformal prediction (raw point predictions)
links.outcome: Prediction errors (correctness of susceptibility predictions) and abstention rate
links.effect: Without conformal prediction, 84% of predictions were correct with six antibiotics as input (major error 19%, very major error 12%); conformal prediction reduced errors, with abstention in 9.6%, 14%, and 22% of instances at 90%, 95%, and 97.5% confidence levels
links.tradeoff: Increased abstentions (9.6%, 14%, 22% of instances at 90%, 95%, 97.5% confidence), meaning those cases receive no AI prediction
links.quote: Conformal prediction reduced errors but increased abstentions; at confidence levels of 90%, 95%, and 97.5%, the model abstained in 9.6%, 14%, and 22% of instances.
